claim: Chengdu has two Michelin 2-star restaurants and no 3-stars; Yu Zhi Lan held 2 stars since 2022 and Xin Rong Ji since 2024
quote: Yu Zhi Lan (玉芝兰) Sichuan 2022–2025 (all editions) ... Xin Rong Ji (新荣记) Taizhou 2024–2025

claim: Xin Rong Ji Chengdu address is No. 501, 5F, Chinese Financial Center, 33 Jiaozi Avenue, Wuhou; phone +86 28 6810 2828; signature dishes include sea anemone glass noodles and mapo tofu with cod milt
quote: No. 501, 5F, Chinese Financial Center, 33 Jiaozi Avenue, Wuhou, Chengdu ... sea anemone glass noodles with pickled chillies and mapo tofu with cod milt

claim: Yu Zhi Lan focuses on restraint and technique, using fermented black beans, aged vinegars, and Sichuan peppercorns at measured intensity; signature dishes include Golden Thread Noodles and Lobster Dumplings
quote: Modern Sichuan fine dining emphasizing restraint and technique rather than heat intensity. The kitchen focuses on fermented black beans, aged vinegars, and Sichuan peppercorns at lower intensity levels

claim: Yu Zhi Lan is at 24 Changfa Street, Qingyang District, Chengdu; chef Lan Guijun is described as a local legend; the restaurant featured in Anthony Bourdain's 2016 Chengdu visit
quote: 24 Changfa Street, Qingyang District, Chengdu ... Chengdu's highest rated restaurant, awarded 2 Michelin Stars in January 2022

claim: Yu Zhi Lan's ~20-course menu is divided into cold bites and hot dishes; typical dishes include Strange Flavour Noodles, Fish Maw Mushroom Soup, Morchella mushrooms two ways, and Sea Cucumber Hot-Sour Noodles
quote: Strange Flavour Noodle (featuring sour, sweet, chilli, and numbing flavors) ... Fish maw with mushroom soup ... Morchella mushrooms prepared two ways ... Hot and Sour Noodles with Sea Cucumber ... Lobster dumplings

claim: Yu Zhi Lan set menus range from 600–2,380 RMB per person; a 50% non-refundable deposit is required; the restaurant has only 18 seats and provides printed English menus
quote: Set menus range from 600-2,380 RMB. One reviewer noted 1300 rmb per guest meal. A 50% non-refundable deposit is required for reservations.

claim: Yu Zhi Lan is listed in the World's 50 Best Discovery programme
quote: Yu Zhi Lan - Chengdu - Restaurant - 50Best Discovery

claim: Xin Rong Ji Chengdu holds a Black Pearl 1 Diamond and ranked #56 on Asia's 50 Best (2025); it deliberately contrasts with Sichuan dining's heat; advance reservation strongly advised
quote: Michelin 2 Stars ... Black Pearl 1 Diamond ... Asia's 50 Best Restaurants #56 ... composed materials, controlled light, table spacing wide enough that conversation stays private

claim: Xin Rong Ji tasting menus at the Beijing branch run 1,850–2,580 RMB per person, used as a proxy for Chengdu pricing since Chengdu pricing is not published
quote: tasting menu costs 1850-2580 CNY per person as of July 2023

claim: Xin Rong Ji is a chain with locations across Shanghai, Beijing, Hong Kong, Hangzhou, and Chengdu
The 2026 Chengdu Michelin Guide maintains 2 two-star restaurants with no new promotions; the same two restaurants (Yu Zhi Lan and Xin Rong Ji) held 2-star status
quote: There wasn't much movement in terms of stars at this year's Award Ceremony, with no new venues achieving two stars

claim: In 2025, 2 restaurants with Two MICHELIN Stars and 10 restaurants with One MICHELIN Star retained their distinctions; dietary restrictions can be specified when booking at Yu Zhi Lan
quote: 2 restaurants with Two MICHELIN Stars and 10 restaurants with One MICHELIN Star have retained their distinctions

claim: Dianping (大众点评) and concierge services are practical channels for making reservations at Chengdu Michelin restaurants
quote: contacting restaurants directly by phone or using Chinese platforms like Dianping (大众点评) for reservations
